tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: Search Protologue for prompting and LLM techniques by name, synonym or keyword. Returns matching entries with their one-sentence definitions and canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_term
tools.description: Get the full Protologue entry for one technique: definition, description, synonyms, introduction year, primary sources, canonical URL, permanent identifier and a ready-made citation. Accepts a name, synonym, slug (e.g. 'react') or identifier (e.g. 'PTL-0058').

tools.name: get_related
tools.description: List the techniques Protologue links to a given technique: broader (it is a kind of), narrower (kinds of it) and related.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Protologue's branches (categories) and the techniques in each.
